metadata.purpose: Backend for Predictive UI: hub functions power React monitor/compare/inspector/actions.
metadata.changelog: 1.2.0 — Bundle structured as UI backend contract (screens → hub functions). 1.1.0 — Period-aware alarms/KPI, trend, compare, search, events. 1.0.0 — Initial package.

migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS spa_asset (
  id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL,
  kks VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  tag VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  toir_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  level VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  parent_id VARCHAR(64),
  status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  has_model BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  kind VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  pos_x DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  pos_y DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  pos_z DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  explode_x DOUBLE PRECISION,
  explode_y DOUBLE PRECISION,
  explode_z DOUBLE PRECISION,
  analytics VARCHAR(2048),
  issue VARCHAR(1024)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS spa_param (
  asset_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL,
  pv VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  sp VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  delta VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  ok BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (asset_id, name)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS spa_defect_point (
  asset_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  t_label VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  point_value DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
  sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (asset_id, sort_order)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS spa_snapshot (
  asset_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  period VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  issue VARCHAR(1024),
  PRIMARY KEY (asset_id, period)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS spa_snapshot_param (
  asset_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  period VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL,
  pv VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  sp VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  delta VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  ok BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (asset_id, period, name)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS spa_snapshot_trend (
  asset_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  period VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL,
  point_value DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (asset_id, period, sort_order)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS spa_event (
  id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
  asset_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  note VARCHAR(2048),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS spa_defect_point;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS spa_snapshot_trend;
CREATE TABLE spa_defect_point (
  asset_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  t_label VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  point_value DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
  sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (asset_id, sort_order)
);
CREATE TABLE spa_snapshot_trend (
  asset_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  period VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL,
  point_value DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (asset_id, period, sort_order)
);
DELETE FROM spa_event;
DELETE FROM spa_snapshot_param;
DELETE FROM spa_snapshot;
DELETE FROM spa_param;
DELETE FROM spa_asset;

source.body: {"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(q)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, name, kks, tag, toir_id AS \"toirId\", level, parent_id AS parent, status, has_model AS \"hasModel\", kind, analytics, issue, pos_x AS \"posX\", pos_y AS \"posY\", pos_z AS \"posZ\", explode_x AS \"explodeX\", explode_y AS \"explodeY\", explode_z AS \"explodeZ\" FROM spa_asset ORDER BY level, name) q"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(q)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, name, kks, tag, status, kind, issue, pos_x AS \"posX\", pos_y AS \"posY\", pos_z AS \"posZ\" FROM spa_asset WHERE level = 'asset' ORDER BY name) q"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(q)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, name, kks, tag, level, status, issue, has_model AS \"hasModel\", kind FROM spa_asset WHERE parent_id = ? ORDER BY name) q", "params": ["${input.parentId}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(q)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, name, kks, tag, toir_id AS \"toirId\", level, parent_id AS parent, status, has_model AS \"hasModel\", kind, analytics, issue, pos_x AS \"posX\", pos_y AS \"posY\", pos_z AS \"posZ\", explode_x AS \"explodeX\", explode_y AS \"explodeY\", explode_z AS \"explodeZ\" FROM spa_asset WHERE id = ?) q", "params": ["${input.id}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(q)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, name, kks, tag, toir_id AS "toirId", level, parent_id AS parent, status, has_model AS "hasModel", kind, analytics, issue, pos_x AS "posX", pos_y AS "posY", pos_z AS "posZ", explode_x AS "explodeX", explode_y AS "explodeY", explode_z AS "explodeZ" FROM spa_asset
            WHERE CONCAT_WS(' ', name, kks, tag, toir_id, COALESCE(issue, '')) ILIKE '%' || ? || '%'
            ORDER BY level, name
            LIMIT 50) q", "params": ["${input.query}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(q)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT a.id, a.name, a.kks, a.tag, a.level,
              COALESCE(s.status, a.status) AS status,
              COALESCE(s.issue, a.issue) AS issue
            FROM spa_asset a
            LEFT JOIN spa_snapshot s ON s.asset_id = a.id AND s.period = ?
            WHERE COALESCE(s.status, a.status) IN ('warning','alarm','critical','nodata')
            ORDER BY CASE COALESCE(s.status, a.status)
              WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'alarm' THEN 2 WHEN 'warning' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, a.name) q", "params": ["${input.period}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(q)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT
              (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM spa_asset WHERE level = 'asset') AS aggregates,
              (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM spa_asset WHERE level = 'node') AS nodes,
              (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM spa_asset WHERE level = 'detail') AS details,
              (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM spa_snapshot s
                 WHERE s.period = ? AND s.status IN ('warning','alarm','critical')) AS deviations) q", "params": ["${input.period}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(q)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT asset_id AS \"assetId\", period, status, issue FROM spa_snapshot WHERE asset_id = ? AND period = ?) q", "params": ["${input.id}", "${input.period}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(q)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT name, pv, sp, delta, ok FROM spa_snapshot_param WHERE asset_id = ? AND period = ? ORDER BY sort_order) q", "params": ["${input.id}", "${input.period}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(q)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT name, pv, sp, delta, ok FROM spa_param WHERE asset_id = ? ORDER BY sort_order) q", "params": ["${input.id}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(q)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT t_label AS t, point_value AS v FROM spa_defect_point WHERE asset_id = ? ORDER BY sort_order) q", "params": ["${input.id}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(q)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT sort_order AS i, point_value AS v FROM spa_snapshot_trend WHERE asset_id = ? AND period = ? ORDER BY sort_order) q", "params": ["${input.id}", "${input.period}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(q)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT a.id, a.name, a.kks, a.level,
              sb.status AS "statusB", sa.status AS "statusA",
              sb.issue AS "issueB", sa.issue AS "issueA"
            FROM spa_asset a
            LEFT JOIN spa_snapshot sb ON sb.asset_id = a.id AND sb.period = ?
            LEFT JOIN spa_snapshot sa ON sa.asset_id = a.id AND sa.period = ?
            WHERE a.id = ? OR a.parent_id = ? OR a.parent_id IN (SELECT id FROM spa_asset WHERE parent_id = ?)
            ORDER BY CASE a.level WHEN 'asset' THEN 0 WHEN 'node' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, a.name) q", "params": ["${input.periodB}", "${input.periodA}", "${input.aggregateId}", "${input.aggregateId}", "${input.aggregateId}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(q)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, asset_id AS \"assetId\", kind, note, created_at AS \"createdAt\"\n            FROM spa_event ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100) q"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

reports.title: Сравнение периодов (снимок live vs fault-7d)
reports.query:
SELECT a.id, a.name, a.level,
              sl.status AS status_live, sf.status AS status_7d,
              sl.issue AS issue_live, sf.issue AS issue_7d
            FROM spa_asset a
            LEFT JOIN spa_snapshot sl ON sl.asset_id = a.id AND sl.period = 'live'
            LEFT JOIN spa_snapshot sf ON sf.asset_id = a.id AND sf.period = 'fault-7d'
            WHERE a.level IN ('asset','node')
            ORDER BY a.level, a.name
